title: Mochizuki Honami — Just Get Over This Feeling〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: See you! Good luck with band practice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Today, we'll be doing the debrief for our solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I did my best to summarize what I could remember...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I had so much fun that I'm not sure I was able to go about it objectively.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I still can't believe we did our own solo show...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can still hear the audience cheering...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It really was the best show we've ever done.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Mochizuki, are you headed to band practice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we're doing the debrief for our solo show today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Congratulations.
It was a really good show, and I'm glad I was there to see it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was? That's good to...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no! I never properly thanked you for coming to see our show!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay. I know how busy these things are, especially before and after.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We went through the same thing for our first solo show. So, don't worry about it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But while we're on the subject, would you mind telling me more about what you thought? I'd like to share it at today's debrief.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course.
I'm not sure if this will help...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But...
The atmosphere you created left a huge impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The atmosphere?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. You grabbed the audience's attention with your first song and kept raising the energy with each subsequent one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There was some tension in the air at first, but you didn't let it bother you... That quickly turned into you all having a lot of fun while playing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(The audience felt it.
They sensed that we were having a lot of fun...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, I wish I could describe it better.
But does that make sense...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you illustrated a wonderful picture...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really can't thank you enough, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I doubt our solo show would've gone as well as it did if I hadn't asked you about it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The people who come to see you only have one thing in mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They just want to see an incredible show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, there was one other thing on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We want to enjoy our show from the bottom of our hearts, just as much as our fans do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you fall into the trap of thinking “our show has to be fun”, it ends up being pretty dull and the audience will notice right away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, it's important to do something that you yourselves enjoy and are satisfied with. We really tried not to forget that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You reminded me of something very important that time, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As a result, I was able to realize that I needed to ask those around me for more help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, thank you for telling me everything you did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I probably have a little more experience than your average person when it comes to live performances, so please feel free to ask me for advice whenever.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, I may have to take you up on that offer.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, things have been going well between you and that scout, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, so... We're currently waiting to hear back from him. But he did say that he'd probably have good news....

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
It was an incredible show, so I can't wait to hear what comes of it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, sorry for keeping you for so long. I was really only expecting to have a quick chat with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I've been meaning to talk to you as well, so I'm really glad we were able to.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's good to hear...
Then, let's both keep doing our best at practice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
See you later, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I was able to thank her again...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But Kiritani isn't the only one who's been helping us. We really should try to find the time to go around and thank everyone else for what they've done...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll try asking the others about this after our debrief.)
